column1: # Fixed trace manifest - RQ-4 E1 (frozen experiment_plan.md 1.3/1.4, E1)
10 seeded replications of the fixed 10,000-request trace (one file per seed).
Each file has columns: seq, unit_dt (exponential mean 1, scaled per cell to the
cell's Poisson rate), u_class (uniform [0,1); hot iff u_class < p_hot),
All cells replay the SAME recorded traces (identical inter-arrival sequences
across policies - Confounder 5); arrival times are rescaled per cell:
t_arr = cumsum(unit_dt)/lam with lam = load_frac * lambda_sat(p_hot, gamma).
